hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Baltussen-Da-Lammers-Martens (JFE 2021): short-gamma hedging pushes the last half hour in the direction of the day's move, and price pressure must revert: the last-half-hour return negatively predicts the next one to three days in index, bond and commodity futures (Table 11). Sign fixed: after a large last half hour that continues the rest-of-day move, FADE it from the 18:00 ET reopen to the next day's close.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m, stype_in=continuous, <ROOT>.v.0, bought 2026-11-09 by batch job AFTER this registration (estimate row first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet, ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/. Times are America/New_York via zoneinfo. P(HH:MM) = CLOSE of the bar opening HH:MM-1min (last trade before HH:MM:00); if that bar is missing, the latest earlier bar within 5 minutes with the same instrument_id, else the observation is ineligible (counted). Any return uses two prices with the same instrument_id (roll rule ex ante). Trading days = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars), early closes skipped. EWMA sigma = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of the squared signal over the instrument's prior eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations (IS warm-up read first). Close time c: ES 16:00 ET, GC 13:30 ET (COMEX settlement). rLH(d) = ln(P(c)/P(c-30min)); rROD(d) = ln(P(c-30min)/P(c) of the previous full session). Trigger iff sign(rLH) = sign(rROD) and |rLH| > 1.5 x EWMA sigma of rLH. Position = -sign(rLH). ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 18:00 ET on d; EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening c-1min on the next full session (ES 15:59, GC 13:29). Skipped if the next session is not a full session. Leg weight w = (0.10/sqrt(252))/sigma_h, sigma_h = EWMA (com 60, >= 40) s.d. of the root's own 18:00->next-close log return; per-event net P&L in fraction of account; ES and GC events pooled into one daily series (same-date events summed).
parameters: window last 30 min; threshold 1.5 sigma; same-sign condition; entry 18:00 open; exit next close; neighbours (fixed now): threshold 1.125 and 1.875 sigma; exit at P(10:30 ET) next session (shorter hold); EWMA com 45 and 75; one-bar-delay = entry at the OPEN of the 18:30 ET bar; volatility terciles = root trailing 20-day s.d. of close-to-close returns (IS bounds). Information only: ES-only and GC-only legs; sub-periods 2015-2020 (inside the paper's window) and 2021-2024 (clean).
instruments: CME ES and COMEX GC front futures (MES/MGC for sizing)
holding: overnight session to next close, about 40-80 events/yr pooled
cost_model: per side: ES 0.50 pt x $50 + $2.50 at the 18:00 entry (thin reopen book), 0.30 pt at the RTH exit; GC 0.20 pt x $100 + $2.50 at 18:00, 0.10 pt at 13:29; 2x run doubles.
notes: Evidence window ~1974-2020 pooled futures: OOS 2015-2020 is inside it (derivative), 2021-2024 clean - both reported. Published R2 < 0.3%, haircut 0.5. Closed relatives: H0006/H0019 use the same last half hour for same-day momentum (closed); this row trades the next-day reversal. Firm: overnight-session futures, entry after 18:00 ET and exit before the next afternoon deadline (Topstep 16:10 ET; ES exit at 15:59).

data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (data bought after this registration): sha256 of each derived parquet written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read; the result file prints manifest = recomputed
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (IS read for warm-up first): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West lag 10 and the ET-date-clustered t of the net-1x per-event series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) PARAMETERS.md criteria 4 and 7: >= 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, >= 2 of 3 IS-bounded volatility terciles positive, every +-25% neighbour in parameters net-positive, the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team / re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Mechanical verdict: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3); NEAR-MISS if deciding t >= 2.6807 with bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL. Before the OOS read, on IS only: truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; decision unchanged), perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
